application.name: ISP
application.description: Turns raw Bayer frames of a synthetic sensor (a moving colour checker scene with known black levels, white balance and vignetting, 8 to 16 bits or packed RAW10/RAW12) into RGB on the GPU with holoscan-isp's IspOp, checks every frame's PSNR against ground truth, and shows the raw mosaic beside the processed image in HoloViz.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-isp demo, with a synthetic raw source checked against ground truth, a raw and processed HoloViz view, and an offscreen render check.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Process 300 frames of the synthetic 1280x720 12-bit sensor, check each against ground truth, and show the raw mosaic beside the processed image when a display is available.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic 640x480 12-bit frames through IspOp with the Malvar-He-Cutler demosaic, every frame's PSNR against ground truth above 28 dB and every histogram complete.
